item.title: No man's an island
item.description: Here's the first draft of my first SCP article, up for review.
item.content:encoded:
http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/retrom

The story of a lonely SCP and the doctor who became his friend.

It's the first time I write on here, so actually pretty much any advice or critique would help me improve it so I can post it eventually, but I would really like help about the formatting of the page, the structure of my story elements and dialogue tips as well.

The title came from Grigori Karpin as I have really no other idea for a title, so if someone has something else, it could be nice.

Also, here's the link to my greenlight : http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13816271 and it is in my sandbox as well.

The article is 2,245 words long and it's important to note that there is a bit of violence (self-harm) in the incident report addendum.

Hope you (the kind reviewer who sees this) like it and merry christmas in advance.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Howdy. Be prepared for mind-boggling weirdness, as is my brand.

http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/iamtheooga
You'll know the tab when you see it, it's the one that takes up the entire second row. Any and all feedback is appreciated, but the big thing I'm looking for is if it's enjoyable to read. Did you like it, did you laugh, do you think it's ready to post? It's also my first article in like a year, so I'm certain there's all sorts of little mistakes that need fixing. I know that the final log is a bit weird, so I'd love to know how I should improve it.

Thanks in advance for your time!

item.title: Drooling Path 3
item.description: Third installment in my Tale series about word salad. 2370 words
item.content:encoded:
I wrote two tales a long time ago about an unhinged researcher's quest to solve the mysteries behind SCP-058, SCP-1981, and certain other SCPs yet to be revealed. Now, part three is finally complete(ish) and I am ready for some feedback.

My biggest concerns are:

  • Is there too much boring stuff unrelated to the plot?
  • Is the pacing wonky?
  • Is the ending too abrupt/does it not leave a strong enough impression?

It's the tab called "Drooling Path 3", naturally:

http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/kothardarastrix

item.title: Impregnating Ultrasound (Tale)
item.description: She loves him like her own, she'll have him as her own. After all, how is a sterile woman to have a baby?
item.content:encoded:
http://kontainer.djkakt.us/impregnating-ultrasound-secondary-draft

Word count: 3800-ish

Concerns:

  • Pacing
  • Character development
  • Dialogue
  • Story
  • Dynamic between Lisa and James
  • Enough show as well as not too much tell

A woman with a bad childhood vows to have her own kid to give them what she never had. They discovers she is sterile and settles for adoption. One day, she finds an anomalous ultrasound that impregnates the woman with a de-aged version of whatever operator is using it at the time. After that, she realizes her adoptive son can truly be hers.

STAFF NOTICE: According to the Draft Forum Guidelines, please do not post your entire draft in the forums. Make a sandbox page, and keep your draft there.

If the only copy of your draft is in this post, you can recover the text by clicking the 'Last edited on [dd/mm/yyyy], [time] by [username] Show more' section found in lower right corner of this post. Then click 'Show revision' to find the full draft from before. Copy that full draft and paste it into your sandbox page. Please note that 'Show revision' does not change the post back.
